name: Extra Special Torches
body:
You are extremely adept and efficient at making special pyro torches.

Prerequisite(s): Special torch class feature.

Benefit(s): You can create three additional special torches per day.

Special: You can take Extra Special Torches multiple times. Its effects stack.
